plate.title: B01 · Brick panels and growing sprays
plate.description: The two offset brick interiors carry horizontal cartouches or narrow rooted sprays. Leaf growth stays within the course; the running-bond joints remain readable.

constructionNotes: The two offset brick interiors carry horizontal cartouches or narrow rooted sprays. Leaf growth stays within the course; the running-bond joints remain readable. Optional curved display selects only intended flowing paths and retains actual roots, tips and seam landmarks; native execution remains finite chords.
